titleScenarios.sameWinnerAndSameRunnerUp: runner-up directly; repeated third/fourth directly ranked if prior positions settled
titleScenarios.threeDistinctRepeatedWinnerRunnerUp: that club bye to final; other two play semifinal
titleScenarios.threeDistinctRepeatedRunnerUp: repeated runner-up third; winners play Finalissima

relegationScenarios.oneRepeated: one direct; other two play single decider
relegationScenarios.fourDistinct: Opening bottom-group rank5 vs Closing rank6, and Opening rank6 vs Closing rank5; losers relegated
relegationScenarios.exception: bottom-two club also top-two in either round exempt from one-overlap playoff; opponent relegated

rules.aggregateScope: include Top6 for comparison if both clubs played Top6 in both rounds, otherwise only 11-match league phases
